description: Case C1: every required fact for motor_vehicle_damage_v1 is present under its canonical key, so the matter reaches CLASSIFIED with no questions.
why_it_exists: Validate Plan JSON gated on 'requires_information || missing.length > 0' with no distinction between a required fact and an optional one. Observed live: a matter reached CLASSIFIED and then dropped back to NEEDS_INFORMATION over repair_quote_amount and prior_communications, both of which are optional_facts. Only missing REQUIRED facts gate now.

input.facts_json: {"incident_description": "Rear quarter panel struck while the vehicle was parked and unattended.", "incident_datetime": "UNVERIFIED: unknown; discovered 2026-08-14 about 18:00 AWST; occurred while parked", "incident_location": "Level 2, Hay Street car park, Perth WA", "owner_present": "no", "driver_identity": "vehicle was unattended", "own_vehicle_registration": "9XYZ876", "damage_description": "Dent and paint transfer to the rear quarter panel."}

items.facts_json: {"incident_description": "Rear quarter panel struck while the vehicle was parked and unattended.", "incident_datetime": "UNVERIFIED: unknown; discovered 2026-08-14 about 18:00 AWST; occurred while parked", "incident_location": "Level 2, Hay Street car park, Perth WA", "owner_present": "no", "driver_identity": "vehicle was unattended", "own_vehicle_registration": "9XYZ876", "damage_description": "Dent and paint transfer to the rear quarter panel."}

assertions: A missing OPTIONAL fact never sets requires_information and never moves the matter to NEEDS_INFORMATION.
missing_facts_json is narrowed to required facts only; optional gaps move to optional_missing_facts_json.
MATERIAL_FACTS_MISSING is actively removed from risk_flags when no required fact is missing.
OPTIONAL_FACTS_OUTSTANDING is raised instead, so the gap is on the record without blocking the matter.
No question is asked and no proceed_hint is offered when nothing required is missing.
